title: BSTW small studio — initial organizational plan

scale.policy: At most five distinct participating people per scenario; a person with several capabilities still counts once.

people.name: Owner / game director
people.notes: Creative direction is declared. No art/programming capability, willingness for a particular assignment, or sprint capacity is inferred.

tools.label: Current Rpgtk Explorer
tools.notes: Inspect and play supported content. Demo-specific execution is unverified; no editor is implied.

tools.label: Original Toolkit editor — candidate external route
tools.support: candidate external route; local access and round trip unverified

tools.label: Source editing environment
tools.support: studio access unverified; repository can hold source

tools.label: External art editor — unselected
tools.support: candidate; choose exact tool and verify output/import route

processes.label: Brief → contribution → review → exact build selection
processes.status: partly specified; #146 proposes local submission; shared review/build selection planned

processes.label: Director records review of an exact revision
processes.status: proposed manual process supported by this planning contract; no permission service claimed

values.rule: People own creative decisions and game artwork; AI may propose decomposition, sequencing, implementation and checks. AI-created game art requires an explicit decision.
Keep planning practical for one to five people; expand a work item only when needed for assignment, a meaningful blocker or acceptance.
A resource must be both capable and willing/available. Unknown is not a commitment.
Separate claimed capability, tool implementation, available inputs, completion, review and build selection.
Keep original private archives, assets, dialogue, source and DLLs local. This plan contains summaries only.

sources.summary: One to five people; island start, climb cliff, broken bridge redirects into town, exploration/clues/mysteries; project and studio plans yield assumption-dependent execution options.
A01 cave terrain floor/wall/exit edge, 32×32; C01/C13/C14 alternative tile supply, C15 assembly, C16 export; conditional C17. A02 and A05 are mentioned but not fully defined here.
W01–W07 requirement/work/variant/review/build relationships; exact revisions; production-route alternatives.
Shipped inspection and limited TK3 execution; these do not establish asset authoring.
Owner-led intake contract, procedural/core Toolkit direction, combat provisionally excluded. Issue body still awaits detailed intake; no comments at this checkpoint.
Open PR at checkpoint. Version 1 local tile manifest and proposed GPH revisions. Neither main nor deployment support is claimed.
Readable vocabulary, explainable matches, independent readiness and complete briefs; documentation merged through #148.
